statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-14456 ("Unbounded Memory Growth in QUIC Server Incoming Channel Queue"): an OpenSSL QUIC server (listener) that receives valid QUIC Initial packets for unknown destination connection IDs allocates and queues new incoming channels without any limit, so a remote peer can make it consume memory without bound. It affects OpenSSL 3.5 and is fixed in OpenSSL 3.5.8: https://openssl-library.org/news/secadv/20260813.txt, fix on the openssl-3.5 branch https://github.com/openssl/openssl/commit/08e7756c3900bcfd77a720e7b74e27d6e4ed01a9. Alpine lists it fixed in openssl 3.5.8-r0 (https://security.alpinelinux.org/vuln/CVE-2026-14456). The DHI Alpine 3.23 openssl packages (origin openssl, including openssl-fips in the DHI security repository) are published as 3.5.4-r0, 3.5.5-r0, 3.5.5_git20260330-r1, 3.5.6-r0, 3.5.6-r1, 3.5.7-r0, 3.5.7-r1, 3.5.8-r0, 3.5.8-r1, 3.5.9-r0, 3.5.9-r1 and 3.5.9-r2, each for x86_64 and aarch64; the OpenSSL version string in libcrypto.so.3 of every build, read from packages verified against the index checksums, is the OpenSSL release in the package version. Every build before 3.5.8-r0 is based on OpenSSL 3.5.7 or older without the fix, and 3.5.8-r0 and every later build are based on OpenSSL 3.5.8 or later. The QUIC code is not part of the FIPS provider.

CVE-2026-14456 ("Unbounded Memory Growth in QUIC Server Incoming Channel Queue"): an OpenSSL QUIC server (listener) that receives valid QUIC Initial packets for unknown destination connection IDs allocates and queues new incoming channels without any limit, so a remote peer can make it consume memory without bound. It affects OpenSSL 3.5 and is fixed in OpenSSL 3.5.8: https://openssl-library.org/news/secadv/20260813.txt, fix on the openssl-3.5 branch https://github.com/openssl/openssl/commit/08e7756c3900bcfd77a720e7b74e27d6e4ed01a9. Debian fixed it for trixie in openssl 3.5.7-1~deb13u2 (DSA-6465-1): https://security-tracker.debian.org/tracker/CVE-2026-14456. The DHI Debian 13 openssl packages are rebuilds of Debian's trixie openssl, published in the DHI Debian repository and the DHI security repository (the FIPS builds and the openssl-provider-fips package of every build only in the security repository). The Debian changelog shipped in libssl3t64 was read from every published build on amd64 and arm64 (25 versions, packages verified against the index checksums). No build of Debian 3.5.5-1~deb13u2, 3.5.6-1~deb13u1 or 3.5.6-1~deb13u2, FIPS builds included, names CVE-2026-14456; the first published rebuild of Debian 3.5.7-1~deb13u2, the fixed boundary here, and every later build, including the FIPS builds of 3.5.7-1~deb13u2, 3.5.7-1~deb13u3 and 3.5.9-1~deb13u1, carry Debian's 3.5.7-1~deb13u2 entry naming it. The openssl-provider-fips package, read from every build on both architectures, ships the OpenSSL 3.1.2 FIPS provider in the FIPS builds and the FIPS provider from the same OpenSSL release (3.5.5, 3.5.6, 3.5.7 or 3.5.9) in the other builds. The QUIC code is not part of either FIPS provider.
